info.name: WHEN IN API Testing
info.description: Postman requests for the WHEN IN Next.js API. Read-only requests are safe for the shared development database. Requests that create accounts/cafes/notifications or send email are clearly separated and must be run selectively. Cookie authentication uses Postman's cookie jar.

item.name: 01 - Safe read-only checks
item.description: These requests do not create or modify application data. Run this folder against the shared WHENIN database.

exec: pm.test('Cafe list response shape', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.pagination).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Search returns paginated cafe array', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.pagination).to.have.property('totalRecords'); });
pm.test('Cuisine filter and page size are applied', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.pagination.pageSize).to.eql(5); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Cafe pagination - max page size is capped

exec: pm.test('Server enforces maximum page size of 20', () => pm.expect(body.pagination.pageSize).to.be.at.most(20));
pm.test('Returned count does not exceed effective page size', () => pm.expect(body.data.length).to.be.at.most(body.pagination.pageSize));

item.name: Cafe pagination - invalid page falls back safely

exec: pm.test('Invalid pagination values use safe defaults', () => { pm.expect(body.pagination.currentPage).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.pagination.pageSize).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.pagination.pageSize).to.be.at.most(20); });
pm.test('HTTP 200 when cafeId was populated by cafe list', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Cafe detail response has required fields', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.cafe).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.cafe).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(body.cafe).to.have.property('slug'); });
pm.test('HTTP 404 for invalid cafe ID', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Error response has success false and message', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Offer list response shape', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Offer search returns an array', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('HTTP 200 when offerId was populated by offer list', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Offer details include cafe reference and terms', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property('cafeId'); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property('terms'); });
pm.test('HTTP 404 for invalid offer ID', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Error response has success false and message', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.message).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: 02 - Authenticated API workflow (creates test data)
item.description: Requires a unique test identity. Registration persists a user because there is no user-delete endpoint. Cafe creation generates an in-app notification; deleting the cafe does not delete that notification. Run only against a disposable/local database or with explicit acceptance of those records.

exec: pm.test('Registration response includes user identity', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('email'); });
pm.test('HTTP 400 for missing registration fields', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Invalid-body message is returned', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid request body.'));
pm.test('Credential error is explicit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'));

pm.test('Current user has id, email and name', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('email'); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('name'); });
pm.test('Profile includes user and cafe array', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.user).to.have.property('email'); pm.expect(body.cafes).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Profile PATCH - update test account only

item.name: 05 - Rate limit probe (safe invalid logins)
item.description: Makes 21 invalid login attempts for a nonexistent .invalid email. It does not create accounts or send email. The repository currently has a rate-limit helper but does not apply it to routes, so this test is expected to fail until enforcement is wired in.

item.name: Probe login throttling with 21 invalid attempts

exec: const send = (iteration) => new Promise(resolve => pm.sendRequest({ url, method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: `rate-limit-probe-${pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')}@example.invalid`, password: 'Invalid-Postman-Probe-Password' }) } }, (error, response) => { results.push(error ? 0 : response.code); resolve(); }));
(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 21; i += 1) await send(i); pm.collectionVariables.set('rateLimitStatuses', JSON.stringify(results)); })();
pm.test('Probe sent all 21 invalid login attempts', () => pm.expect(statuses).to.have.length(21));
pm.test('Rate limiter returns HTTP 429 for at least one attempt', () => pm.expect(statuses).to.include(429));
